title: Design System: Imanol Antonio De la Cruz — Portafolio

tape.note: Ramp derived from the opaque base #ded5bb; the token itself is 75% alpha.

display.purpose: The name on the first page only.

h2.purpose: Page and section titles; 40 px line.

h3.purpose: Role statement and in-page sub-headings; 30 px line.

small.purpose: Evidence lines, captions, sub-titles; 20 px line.

label.purpose: Buttons, nav links, inline actions; sentence case, never uppercase kickers.

annotation.purpose: Short factual notes in Bic Ink beside drawn arrows.

fontLoading.source: Google Fonts in the prototype; self-host via next/font in the build.

depth.name: tape-over-print
depth.value: tape strips 84x24 px, rgba(222,213,187,.75), rotate(+/-6deg), top:-12px

depth.name: print-on-paper
depth.value: 10 px white border, 1 px graphite edge, rotate(1deg)
depth.purpose: Separates a real screenshot from the page.

depth.name: page-on-desk
depth.value: 1 px page-edge border on desk background

depth.name: spine-fold
depth.purpose: The one shaded crease; not elevation.

motion.name: ink-draw
motion.value: stroke-dashoffset from path length to 0, 500ms cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1) (ease-out), fill-mode both
motion.purpose: Every ink mark draws itself once when it first enters view. Never loops, never replays on hover.

motion.name: ink-draw-stagger
motion.value: 80ms per mark, max 4 marks per group (320ms)
motion.purpose: Sibling marks in one group (annotations, evidence ticks) draw in reading order.

motion.name: highlighter-sweep
motion.value: background-size 0% 100% -> 100% 100%, left origin, 400ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1), delayed until ink-draw of its group finishes
motion.purpose: The single highlighter swipe sweeps once on entry.

motion.name: press
motion.value: transform scale(.97) composed with any existing rotation, 120ms ease-out in, 160ms ease-out out
motion.purpose: Tactile feedback on buttons and pen-underlined actions.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce): marks render fully drawn, highlighter shown fully, press uses colour only, scroll-behavior auto
motion.purpose: No movement; all information still present.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.note: Design at 360 and 390. Single stacked page, margin rule at 20 px, content at 40 px, spine replaced by an 8 px double page-edge rule, nav links scroll horizontally.

breakpoints.name: tablet
breakpoints.note: Two-page spread, page padding 40 px sides, margin rule at 30 px.

breakpoints.name: desktop
breakpoints.note: Full spread at max 1280 px, margin rule at 40 px, content at 80 px, padding 60/60/40.

strokeMarks.color: ink (#1f3a93) only; error marks may use error (#a3291f)
strokeMarks.strokeWidth: 2px for marks in text (tick, circle, strike, underline); 2.5px for annotation arrows
strokeMarks.caps: round caps and joins; fill none
strokeMarks.geometry: Irregular, slightly unclosed paths drawn as SVG (circles overshoot their start, ticks have a curved long stroke, arrows have an open head). Never font glyphs.

vocabulary.circle: Around one key word per screen (e.g. "backend"); SVG absolutely positioned with -8 px inset, preserveAspectRatio none.
vocabulary.tick: Verified evidence. 20x20 in the 30 px evidence gutter.
vocabulary.pending-circle: Pending evidence, with the reason in words.
vocabulary.strike: Unavailable item: one 2 px ink line through the text, reason stated in words.
vocabulary.arrow: 40x20 lead-in for annotations; 16x16 directional arrows in actions (external, download).
vocabulary.underline: 2 px pen underline for secondary actions and active nav.

strokeMarks.a11y: Marks are aria-hidden; state is always also in text (or visually hidden text).

narrative.overview:
The site is a quad-ruled notebook lying open on a desk. Warm paper carries a 5 mm (20 px) blue grid and one red margin rule; the author writes over it in Bic-blue ink: circles around the words that matter, ticks beside verified facts, arrows from a screenshot to what it proves, a pen underline under a secondary action. Real screenshots are printed and taped in, never floated in glass. Set text is graphite in one sturdy grotesk; the hand shows only in strokes, never in a handwriting font.

Density is a working notebook, not a magazine: content sits on the grid, margins are generous but measured in cells, and every mark carries information. State is written, not lit: ✓ verified, ○ pending, struck through = unavailable. Depth comes only from overlap: tape over a print, a print over the page, a page over the desk. The world refuses the dark-neon developer portfolio entirely: no graphite-and-lime HUD, no mono kicker labels, no glass, no glow.

The notebook is professional first. Personality lives in the precision of the marks and the honesty of the annotations (synthetic data labelled as synthetic, pending dates marked pending), not in decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper on a slightly darker desk, a 20 px blue quad grid, one red margin rule per page.
Bic-blue ink is the only accent that acts: buttons, links, marks, annotations.
One highlighter swipe per screen, on the strongest single piece of evidence.
Square everything: paper, prints, tape, buttons. Slight hand-placed rotation (±1°) on prints and the primary button.
Depth by overlap only; no blurred shadows.
Irregular SVG ink strokes that draw themselves once, and are simply present under reduced motion.

rules.name: The One Pen Rule
rules.body: Blue ink is the only colour that marks or acts. Red belongs to the margin and to errors; it never circles, ticks or underlines.

rules.name: The One Swipe Rule
rules.body: At most one highlighter swipe is visible per screen, on the single strongest piece of evidence. A second highlight means neither is the strongest.

rules.name: The Set Type Rule
rules.body: Text is always set in Schibsted Grotesk. No handwriting, script or "marker" fonts, ever; the hand is the strokes.

rules.name: The Grid Line Rule
rules.body: Headings, small text, labels and component heights snap to the 20 px grid (40 px, 30 px half-steps, 20 px). Body prose keeps 1.5 for readability and does not chase grid lines; blocks re-align through their margins.

rules.name: The Cell Rule
rules.body: If a measurement is not a multiple of 10 px, it is wrong unless it is a 1–2 px stroke or a 48 px touch target.

rules.name: The Overlap Rule
rules.body: If something must look raised, put it on top of something else. Never add box-shadow, glow, blur or backdrop-filter.

dos: Do keep every measurement on the 20 px cell (10 px half-steps), except 1–2 px strokes and 48 px touch targets.
Do draw every mark (circle, tick, ○, arrow, strike, underline) as an irregular SVG stroke in Bic Ink (#1f3a93).
Do let ink marks draw once on entry (500 ms ease-out, 80 ms stagger) and render them fully drawn under reduced motion.
Do mark state with ✓ verified, ○ pending, struck = unavailable, always with words beside the mark.
Do label synthetic data as synthetic on every taped screenshot.
Do create depth by overlap: tape over print over paper over desk.
donts: Don't use handwriting, script or marker fonts.
Don't use gradient text, glass, backdrop blur, glow or blurred drop shadows.
Don't use a dark or neon theme, or any part of the old graphite + lime HUD (Space Grotesk, JetBrains Mono, #101214, #C2F362).
Don't use more than one highlighter swipe per screen.
Don't use an "IA" monogram or any generated or simulated portrait; omit the portrait slot until a real photo exists.
Don't show availability indicators, response-time promises or status dots.
Don't invent metrics, proficiency bars, percentages or counts.
Don't use red ink for marks or emphasis; red is the margin and errors only.
Don't use mono or uppercase kicker/eyebrow labels above headings.
Don't use font glyph icons (↗, ↓, ✓ as text) in place of drawn strokes.
